The Wizard starts with the ordinary +1 quarterstaff wielded; the uncursed scroll exercises the normal positive-enchantment path. The first wished object is expected in the first free inventory slot from prior C menu observations, but the C run—not any JavaScript result—will determine whether selector p reaches the scroll.
